rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned hidden reality
absolutive expressing prior act of cognition
compound object of knowing; gūḍha (hidden) + sadbhāva (true-nature)
state that arises as the result of that knowledge
main verb stating the emergence of omniscience

items.question: What realization brings about the arising of omniscience in the knower?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of realization.
That hidden true nature can be directly known.
Knowing that hidden true nature produces a transformative result.
items.inference: Therefore, having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
uncertainties: The gender and exact referent of taṃ depend on the broader context of the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
